name: Woman Who Gave Her Cloak
background: A woman from the crowd who spread her cloak on the road. Spontaneous devotion — part of the Hosanna movement.

genericReactions.physical: My devotion is a matter of the heart, not of physical things.
genericReactions.testimonial: My actions speak for my faith. What more is there to say?
genericReactions.digital: Such matters are beyond my concern. I follow the path of light.
genericReactions.environmental: The very stones cry out in praise! How can one not see it?
genericReactions.analytical: You can't measure faith with numbers.
genericReactions.prophecy: Everything is happening as it was foretold. It is a blessed time.
